 White Sox, Rockies Make Surprise Luis Castillo Trade, New MLB Rumors Reveal Details
 Zach Bachar Nov 19, 2026 The Colorado Rockies reportedly acquired Chicago White Sox starting pitcher Luis Castillo in a trade on Thursday.
 According to ESPN's Jeff Passan , the Rockies received Castillo and right-hander Davis Martin from the White Sox in exchange for two prospects. Colorado will take on Castillo's full salary as part of the deal.
 The two prospects that Chicago received in the swap included left-handed pitcher Sean Sullivan and catcher Douglas Veliz, per ESPN's Jesse Rogers and the New York Post 's Jon Heyman .
